title: Data Entry Admin - Basingstoke
description:
Data Entry/Administration Support

Contract Type: Fixed-term contract - End of October
Location: Basingstoke
Hourly Rate: £15.20
Start Date: ASAP
Working Pattern: Full Time, 37 hours per week (Monday to Friday)

Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with a leading organization in the transportation sector? We are seeking enthusiastic and detail-oriented individuals to join our team as Data Entry/Administration Support! This is a fantastic opportunity to contribute to a vital project as we transition to a new rostering system.

Role Purpose:
As part of our team, you will play a key role in supporting the implementation of our new rostering system. Your efforts will assist our staff in running the new system parallel to the existing one, ensuring a smooth transition and effective operations.

Key Responsibilities:
- Input data into the new rostering system accurately and efficiently.
- Provide administrative support to existing staff as needed.
- Report any issues to the Team Lead to ensure quick resolution.

Essential Skills and Experience:
- Proven experience in data input and administration duties.
- Strong skills in coordinating, information gathering, and reporting.
- Quick learner-training will be provided!

Desirable:
- Experience within the rail or passenger transport sector, particularly in staff rostering.

Knowledge and Capability:
- Experience in a fast-paced office environment.
- Excellent data input speeds-accuracy is critical!

Personal Attributes:
- Highly organized with a keen attention to detail.
- Calm and effective under pressure, especially during time-sensitive tasks.
- Strong communicator who engages confidently with the team.
- Adaptable and eager to learn new skills.

Join our dynamic team and be part of a project that makes a difference! If you are ready to bring your talents to a fast-paced environment and thrive in a role that requires precision and adaptability, we want to hear from you!

How to Apply:
Don't miss out on this exciting opportunity! Send your application and CV today to join our dedicated team. We can't wait to meet you!

Get ready to take your career to the next level with us!

Adecco is a disability-confident employer. It is important to us that we run an inclusive and accessible recruitment process to support candidates of all backgrounds and all abilities to apply. Adecco is committed to building a supportive environment for you to explore the next steps in your career. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage, please let us know and we will be happy to support you.

Adecco acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. The Adecco Group UK & Ireland is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

title: Sales Administrator
description:
Sales Administrator - Temp to Perm

Location: Basingstoke, Hampshire
Salary: £13.25 per hour (in the region of £28,000 upon successful temp completion)
Job Type: Temporary to Permanent
Hours: Full-time, 0800 to 1700, Monday to Friday

Vanta Staffing are currently recruiting for a Sales Administrator to join a successful and growing business based in Basingstoke. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised, proactive and customer-focused individual to join the team on a temp-to-perm basis, with the opportunity to secure a permanent position following a successful temporary period.

Our client is an established, employee-owned business with a strong people-first culture. They pride themselves on providing an exceptional service to their customers and have built a supportive, collaborative and hands-on working environment.

The Role

As a Sales Administrator, you will play an important role in supporting the sales and branch operations, ensuring customers receive a professional and efficient service. Working closely with the General Manager and Sales Supervisor, you will be responsible for a variety of administrative and customer service duties.

Key Responsibilities
- Respond to customer enquiries via telephone, email and in person in a professional and timely manner.
- Process customer orders, quotations, enquiries and returns accurately and efficiently.
- Build and maintain positive relationships with customers and colleagues.
- Handle customer complaints and resolve issues effectively, escalating where appropriate.
- Provide administrative support to the General Manager and wider branch team.
- Assist with data entry, reporting and document management.
- Support the branch with statutory, regulatory, Health & Safety and compliance requirements.
- Maintain accurate records and ensure information is kept up to date.
- Assist with general sales and administrative duties as required by the General Manager and Sales Supervisor.
- Work collaboratively with the wider team to ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the branch.

About You

We are looking for someone who is organised, commercially aware and customer-focused, with a proactive approach to their work.

The successful candidate will ideally have:
- Previous experience within sales administration, office administration, customer service or a similar role.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good analytical and problem-solving abilities.
- A proactive approach and the ability to use your own initiative.
- Strong IT skills, including good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word.
- The ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a busy environment.
- A positive, flexible and team-focused attitude.
- A genuine commitment to providing excellent customer service.

What's on Offer?
- Temp-to-perm opportunity
- 25 days annual leave + Bank Holidays upon permanent employment
- Statutory pension
- Company performance-related bonus scheme
- Share Purchase Scheme
- On-site parking
- Supportive and inclusive working environment
- Opportunity to join a growing, employee-owned business
- Excellent long-term career prospects

Why Join?

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone looking to build a long-term career within a successful and growing organisation. You will be joining a business where employees are genuinely valued and encouraged to contribute, develop and grow.

Vanta Staffing are proud to be recruiting for this opportunity and are looking for candidates who are keen to secure a permanent position following a successful temporary assignment.

If you are organised, customer-focused and looking for your next opportunity, we would love to hear from you. Apply today with Vanta Staffing!

Vanta Staffing are working as an employment agency in relation to this role
